items.issue: The 21-day duration and predicted transformation or gratitude are presented without measurement or evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as a proposed exercise only; no timeline or outcome promise.

items.issue: The instruction to refuse one person every day may encourage arbitrary refusal rather than principled boundaries.
items.disposition: If later adapted, limit practice to real unreasonable requests or honest preferences, without manufacturing conflict.

items.issue: The instruction to act confident or '装逼' is ambiguous between graded rehearsal and deceptive persona performance.
items.disposition: Use only transparent, low-stakes skill rehearsal; do not endorse false identity, intimidation or misrepresentation.

items.issue: Joker's violence and distorted selfhood are used as a symbol of strong subjectivity despite an explicit non-harm disclaimer.
items.disposition: Keep the disclaimer inseparable and do not use the character as a healthy-behavior model.

items.issue: Internal standards can be misread as making other people's feedback and preferences irrelevant.
items.disposition: Preserve the distinction between self-worth and accountability; others retain equal choice and boundaries.

items.issue: The main framework overlaps mikey-gameshengjing-003, mikey-gameshengjing-017 and other self/boundary sources.
items.disposition: Count as a distinct four-step presentation but give no extra effect confidence to repetition.

items.issue: Late English film dialogue and earlier fictional examples could be misattributed to Mikey.
items.disposition: Keep attributed to third-party film clips; do not quote as Mikey's original language.

items.issue: ASR corrupts Adler, Parasite, film titles and several action phrases.
